report.root_cause: No incident. One "Can't keep up" warning (56 ticks behind) during startup and one player reconnect (Steve_Mines, connection reset at 06:41:58, rejoined 06:42:04) were normal. TPS held at about 19.8–20, entity count stayed at 24, chunk count at 756, heap went up and down between about 310 and 430 MB with garbage collection, no plugins disabled, and disk use stayed at 5%.
report.actions: Checked status and logs, then kept watching with wait for about 264 s. Read the logs again partway through. I changed nothing: no commands, no file changes, no restarts, no bans.
report.residual_risk: Low. The server runs in offline mode (online-mode=false), so it doesn't check usernames and anyone can log in as any player. That seems to be how it's meant to be set up, so I left it alone. Average MSPT sometimes rose to about 30 but TPS stayed at 20.
